structuredContent.text:
## Problem

The product search index is rebuilt every hour from a full export, which takes 40 minutes and makes new products invisible for up to an hour. Customers filed 23 tickets in July 2026 about missing products.

content.text:
The product search index is rebuilt in full every hour from a complete export. The rebuild takes 40 minutes. Because of that, new products can stay invisible in search for up to an hour. Customers filed 23 tickets about missing products in July 2026.

Source: `specs/search-index-rewrite.md`, "Problem" section (lines 5–7).
